publishedRecipe.name: Spiced Turkey Bowl with Basil Slaw, Cucumber, Avocado & Sesame Sauce

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 (1 inch) pieces ginger root
2 small pkgs fresh basil
2 medium carrots
1 English cucumber
1 avocado

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, peel and mince garlic.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add garlic, turkey, and spices; cook, breaking the turkey apart with a spoon, until browned and crumbly, 4-5 minutes. Remove from heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
4 tsp toasted sesame oil
1 ½ lb ground turkey
1 tsp cumin, ground
1 tsp turmeric, ground
½ tsp coriander, ground
½ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, peel and mince ginger; place in a small bowl along with tahini, oil, vinegar, water, soy sauce, and maple syrup. Whisk to combine the sauce and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
¼ cup tahini
2 tbsp toasted sesame oil
2 tbsp rice vinegar
2 tbsp water
2 tbsp soy sauce
1 tsp pure maple syrup

instructions.primary_message: Pick basil leaves off the stems, roll up crosswise, and thinly slice into ribbons. Place in a large bowl (reserving a small amount for garnish).
Peel, trim, and coarsely grate carrots; add to the bowl with the basil, along with broccoli slaw, and toss to combine.
Trim and thinly slice cucumber crosswise into rounds.
Halve and pit avocado. Slice thinly while still in the skin, then scoop out with a spoon.
Divide slaw between bowls; top with turkey, cucumber, avocado, and reserved basil. Drizzle sauce over top and enjoy!
